protocol: One frozen stop-only revision after inspecting the 23 disputed first states. Same bounded SkillOpt trust clause, 91 native HCL memories, router, crop tool, four calls, reader and judge. The previous blanket stop is replaced by a veto only on a proposed real next tool. Honor base stop. If trusted evidence is empty continue; otherwise generate one quoted supporting passage. Verify literal presence in accepted text, then require semantic sufficiency in both A/B label orientations. If a condition fails use the proposed tool. Compare to old bounded policy, repaired baseline, and matched router-stop with identical trust arbiter. Clinical correctness is scored after trajectories, never enters the stop rule. Report 16 gate and all 45 exploratory, fixed 23 vs other 22, costs, wins/losses, full per-case anonymous audit. Replace deployment only if strictly more gate cases correct than baseline. Also ablate old state factor by withholding current draft and/or naming the concrete proposed tool in the continue option on those 23 states. No parameter selection from rerun outcomes.
